facts.fact_source: Parsed from the URDF at the pinned upstream commit: link/joint elements, inertial masses, joint types and mimic tags (the gripper's right finger joint mimics the left, so the two prismatic joints count as one gripper degree of freedom).

specimen.annotation_note: This entry arrived by import, not by hand: the description was downloaded by robot_descriptions from ROBOTIS's own open_manipulator repository and the facts above were parsed out of its URDF. Nothing here was gated — importing a description is not a verdict.
honesty: Gate status stays NOT_GATED: the motion gate grades wheeled ground robots, and no arm gate exists yet.
The parts kit stays undefined (kit: null in catalog/parts-kits.json): the kit generator builds wheeled kits from a spec's wheel block, and this robot has no wheels.
The URDF's seven link masses sum to 0.594 kg — the figure this entry already recorded. The e-Manual's 0.70 kg excludes the base plate; the two figures describe different things and both stay.
The URDF tree is not vendored into this repo — the manifest pins the upstream repo, commit and URDF path, and the license above was read from that repo's LICENSE file, not assumed.
